plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-10-02 from the official Case Western Reserve University General Bulletin (2026-27) 'Physics' BS 'Sample Plan of Study' (Biophysics Concentration track) grid (https://bulletin.case.edu/arts-sciences/physics/physics-bs/). Footnotes: 'a': Unified General Education Requirement. 'b': Biogroup Electives (B-group 1-5) are to be chosen in consultation with the biophysics academic advisor from among approved biology, biophysics, biochemistry, and biomedical engineering courses, including certain prerequisites as needed (e.g., chemistry). BIOL 214 and BIOL 215 are suggested for B-group 1 and 2. PHYS 320 may be used as a B-group option if it is not selected as a PHYS technical elective. The listing of credits includes numbers for the most likely choices of courses and, in parentheses, possible alternatives. 'c': The capstone courses PHYS 351 and PHYS 352 are each two semester courses taken in the fall and spring of the students senior year. CREDIT RANGES: Year 1 Fall: 'CHEM 105' printed 3-4; modeled at 3 per official term total 17. Year 1 Spring: 'CHEM 106' printed 3-4; modeled at 3 per official term total 17. Year 2 Fall: 'FOOTNOTE-B-1' printed 3-4; modeled at 3 per official term total 16. Year 4 Spring: 'FOOTNOTE-B-5' printed 3-4; modeled at 3 per official term total 12. 'or' rows are modeled per convention with choice:true, first option as code, and all options in options[]. Rows combining lecture+lab (e.g. 'EBME 306 & EBME 356') are kept as one combined course with the official combined credit total. Unlabeled credit slots are elective choice placeholders. Prerequisites are not printed in the sample plan, so prereq arrays are empty; prerequisites live in the bulletin's course descriptions. REPEATED COURSES: PHYS 351 and PHYS 352 appear(s) in multiple semesters per the official plan. Official plan footnote 'c': 'The capstone courses PHYS 351 and PHYS 352 are each two semester courses taken in the fall and spring of the students senior year.' allow_repeated_courses is set for this reason.
